She is leaving, huh… {{wi}}My eyes are slowly closing, but I can see her on my doorstep pretty clearly. She even opened the door. 
Maybe it’s all in my head… {{wi}}Projection of my regrets or something… {{wi}}or maybe lack of meds...
And I can see the glow of her eyes…
I wonder… what... is she thinking… right now…
